text:
maya: Quick sync — postmortem follow-ups from last outage. We need a concrete plan to automate rollback waves for flagged rollouts and a simple tracker for recurring flag failure patterns. @jonathan can you confirm priority?
jonathan: Yep, this is high priority. Two halves: automation (auto-rollback by error rate + stage timers) and analytics (pattern detection for flags that repeatedly trigger).
linh: +1. Suggest we start with a lightweight automation hook in the rollout service before adding ML detection. We can use existing outage-signal metrics.
maya: Agreed. Proposal sketch: 1) auto-rollback policy templates, 2) rollout-wave controller that escalates 5->20->50 with health checks, 3) persistent action tracker for owners/timelines.
aqeel: Sounds good. For the tracker, product can own the remediation deadlines and tie to postmortem action items. We should surface recurring patterns in the console.
jonathan: Drafted an auto-rollback snippet for the rollout controller:
```
flag: new-ranking-v2
rollout_waves:
  - pct: 5
    hold: 15m
  - pct: 20
    hold: 30m
  - pct: 50
    hold: 1h
auto_rollback:
  enabled: true
  error_rate_threshold: 0.03   # 3%  
  sustained_minutes: 5
```
jonathan: Behavior: if error_rate > threshold for sustained_minutes during a hold, rollback to previous stable immediately and notify owners + oncall.
maya: Love the hold windows. We also need a fast-path emergency rollback for severe incidents (e.g., latency x100 or p95 > 5s). Can that be a separate toggle?
linh: Yes — add an emergency policy: severity_cutoff -> immediate_quarantine. We can wire it into the runtime via the routing layer.
maya: Action items (quick):
- maya: draft PR for rollout-wave controller + tests — ETA Tue EOD
- jonathan: add auto_rollback config support + metrics hooks in rollout service — ETA Wed EOD
- linh: emergency policy design doc + runtime hook spec — ETA Fri
- aqeel: console tracker mockups + labels for recurring pattern tags — ETA Thu
- sre-bot: add recurring-flag alert rule to the incident playbook (low-priority initially)

sre-bot: created task T-4832 and linked playbook: https://rwd.example/tasks/T-4832 :robot_face:
aqeel: For recurring patterns detection — let's start with a simple aggregation: count flags that triggered >=2 rollbacks in 30d, then escalate to product ops for review.
maya: Agreed. Add a column in the tracker: last_rollback_ts, rollback_count_30d, recommended_action (investigate / quarantine / kill).
jonathan: One gotcha — some models have noisy signals. We should allow per-flag overrides for thresholds and hold durations. Document that in the PR.
linh: Also include a safety semaphore so we don't auto rollback during known maintenance windows. Use a simple TTL lock that the deploy system sets.
maya: Good call. We'll include a "maintenance_lock" check in the controller.
aqeel: Can we add a weekly digest to #eng-sre summarizing flags that rolled back? That helps pattern spotting.
maya: Yes — sre-bot can post a digest.
sre-bot: scheduled weekly digest for channel eng-sre every Mon 09:00 UTC. First run 2955080000.
jonathan: I'll open the draft PRs and ping this thread. If anyone wants to pair on tests for the controller, ping me.
maya: Thanks all. We'll treat this as a sprint epic. Keeping owners and ETAs above. We'll sync in the regular SRE/Triage on Friday. :thumbsup:
